description: Agent Education: submit a transfer credit evaluation with the sending institution’s transcript: the evaluation with the receiving and sending institutions, the student, the day evaluated, the lowest grade it states it accepts, each course it addresses with its id, code, title, term, the sending credits and grade as it states them, its decision (applied, elective, accepted or not accepted), the credits awarded and the requirement or course it is applied to, and the accepted and applied totals it states; and optionally the sending transcript with its institution, student and each course with its id, code, title, term, credits and grade. The signed report gives the evaluation with its accepted, applied and refused courses, the transcript, the courses matched, the accepted courses the transcript does not show, the transcript courses left unaddressed, the applied courses naming no requirement and the refused courses carrying credit, the sending credits stated unlike the transcript and the credits awarded above it, the grades stated unlike the transcript and those accepted below the stated minimum, and the stated totals against their lines, and counts them, and names a discrepant evaluation: an accepted course the transcript does not show, more credits awarded than the transcript shows, a grade or sending credits stated unlike the transcript and a stated total above its lines; then a transcript course left unaddressed, a total below its lines, a course accepted below the stated minimum grade, an applied course naming no requirement, a refused course carrying credit and a student or sending institution named otherwise, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No sending transcript, a course with no code, an accepted course with no credits awarded while a total is stated, or a minimum grade that is not a letter grade leaves the evaluation unverified. This reads transfer credit evaluations, not agent lessons: wever_learning-transfer-check reads an agent’s lessons considered for new tasks and contexts, which shares only the word, and wever_migration-mapping-check reads a source-to-target field mapping for one move, while the transfer check reads which courses and credits were accepted and applied, as stated in the evaluation and the sending transcript. Verdict edu_transfer_discrepant, edu_transfer_partial, edu_transfer_unverified or edu_transfer_faithful. POST /api/edu-transfer-check. Reads the education paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no admissions decision, accreditation judgment, aid eligibility decision or evaluation of academic quality or of any person’s ability, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Education reads supplied education paperwork for consistency between documents: a transcript, a diploma or degree certificate, an enrollment verification letter, an education-issued certificate, a course completion record, a transfer credit evaluation, a financial aid award letter and a test score report. Beside it, the Agent Learning checks such as wever_learning-transfer-check read an agent’s own lessons and learning reports, not human education records, while an education check reads no agent lesson; wever_certification-evidence-check reads company certification, compliance and license claims such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS against the evidence offered for them for DiligenceOps, and those claims stay there; and agent credentials stay with wever_credential-requirements-check, which reads whether a listing discloses its credential requirements before payment, and wever_onboarding-credential-check, which reads the credentials issued to a new agent. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-education-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-education/.
